title: Autonomous Cyber AI Product Lead (LLM)
jd_excerpt:
Google LLC in Mountain View, CA, seeks a Senior Product Manager to lead the Production Evaluation and Data Flywheel for Cyber Gemini, guiding products from concept to launch and coordinating between researchers, engineers, and enterprise teams.

You will analyze raw agent trajectories, run statistical assessments, and build autonomous evaluation agents to drive robust cybersecurity solutions, impacting billions of users.
